title: Bedrock Flight
description:
Enhanced creative flight with adjustable settings.
Initially inspired by Bedrock Edition Creative Flying mechanics, but improved.
body:
# Bedrock Flight


![Super cool image that makes you go WOW. it shows a linear and a constant path.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0b8296894f91f1f81c97e2dbc2785b1b226369e.png)

---

## Features:
| Feature | Name |
| --- | --- |
| **Flight Speed** | *Set your flying speed from 0.01f up to 0.1f!* |
| **Deceleration** | *Deceleration can be set from 1.0f (Vanilla Java) down to 0.1f which is basically instant stop! or somewhere in between like the default, 0.65f!* |
| **Spectator Mode Support** | *Now you can enable this flight style in Spectator mode! Off by default.* |
| **Hytale Style Speed Keybinds** | *[Per-User-Request] Hytale style speed modification via keybinds (default-increase: "=", default-decrease: "-")* |
| **Legacy Edition Sprint Flying** | *Basically, when you hold the Sprint key while flying, you fly in the direction you're looking in. INCLUDING up and down.* |

![Screenshot of the settings page.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/122f1c8bce60fdb2dd2a82b96822b362203324e7_0.webp)

## Why?
The mod started as a simple port of Bedrock's creative flight, but I decided to add some configurable features... so yeah!

The default settings are what I found closest to Bedrock Edition's creative flight.


## Before you ask:
- **No** Forge/NeoForge/Quilt ports.
- **Maybe** there will be backports.
- **Yes** it will be updated.
